topic: Sensor data loss at Panorama mall
summary_markdown: Problems were reported regarding sensors Pnr0008dd and Pnr0005dd at Panorama mall. The issues were attributed to internal screen problems, not the company's equipment. Data review showed that JCD_LT_PNR0008DD had no data for one hour (13:55 - 15:00). No data loss was observed for JCD_LT_PNR0005DD.
decisions: Confirmed sensor issues were due to internal screen problems.
